desc: Designed by custom knifemaker Kevin Smock, the Skoli is an all-purpose fixed-blade knife ideal for outdoor adventure. Its versatile design draws on Smock's extensive hunting and camping experience and emphasizes comfort, secure grip, and a well-centered, utilitarian point. The Skoli's blade is crafted from 9Cr18MoV stainless steel and features a modified sheepfoot profile and a flat grind for a superior balance of strength and low-friction edge geometry. Its full tang is flanked by precision-machined, contoured G-10 scales with a high-traction checkered texture. A single quillon (guard) at the front of the handle and a section of jimping (textured grooves) on the spine complement the textured scales to ensure a secure grip and exceptional control in even the most demanding conditions. The Skoli is available in two finish options: a handsome stonewashed finish or a black oxide coating that eliminates its reflective signature. To complement its low-profile coating, the black-bladed Skoli also features black-coated handle hardware. Both versions come complete with a custom-molded, snap-fit Boltaron sheath and a versatile G-Clip mount that supports angle-adjustable carry on the belt and inside the waistband.
